priorFindingDisposition: No blocker or SHOULD-FIX was outstanding against v1 (Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed). v2 is a pure remeasurement successor: it adds the predecessor block and moves the live pins, and changes no obligation, no reason, and no leftoverDesign flag.
observationsNotFindings: PURPOSE CLAUSE WITHOUT AN ANTECEDENT. purpose says 'Replace predecessor self-version closing sentence with the generic form', but v1 has no basedOn.predecessor* block at all and zero 'This vN' sentences — so nothing was replaced; v2 simply ADDED a predecessor block already carrying the generic form. I checked whether this is drafter-specific fabrication and it is not: the identical clause appears in nine leftover-joins across this wave, and in eight of the nine the immediate predecessor genuinely did contain a 'This vN' sentence to replace. This is the single instance where the antecedent does not exist, because v1 was the first version. Not a finding: the clause describes provenance of an edit rather than any measured property; the substantive requirement it names — the predecessor role uses the generic form and no self-version claim exists — genuinely holds in v2 (zero hits); and v1 is frozen and pinned, so the mild misattribution self-corrects on inspection. Worth tidying in a successor.

D-121 RECORDING-KIND LABEL. OBL-AL3-CORE-ROLLBACK says self-update-repair-contract.v3 'is recorded at D-121 as DR-110 leftover T2-02'. D-121's heading reads 'Record self-update-repair-contract.v3 as DR-110's accepted design-contract successor candidate', and I searched its full entry (lines 4940-4990) — 'T2-02' and 'leftover' appear nowhere in it. The corpus does distinguish these kinds deliberately: D-124 and D-125 headings both read 'leftover T2-02 candidate'. So the recording LOCUS (D-121) is correct but the KIND label is not. Not a finding, for four reasons: the obligation stays leftoverDesign TRUE and the subject expressly refuses to claim v3 covers AL-3 core-release-byte rollback, so nothing is licensed by the label; the substantive property cited from v3 is verified true in v3's own bytes ('MUST NOT silently reuse DR-107's generation rollback as if they were the same mechanism'); the error runs in the conservative direction, since 'leftover T2-02' understates rather than overstates v3's standing; and the reason is byte-identical to the ACCEPTed v1 and outside v2's stated remeasurement scope. COORDINATOR NOTE: worth correcting in a successor so the corpus's kind-labels stay clean.
The subject discloses 'Codex not reviewed' for G21 v3 and join v1, reserving the genuinely-dual claim for contract v7 where both reviews exist and are clean.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-one attacks run, twenty-one refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v1 onto live HEAD a11a041 / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with file 08 confirmed moved; the eight-obligation set is unchanged and no obligation reason was touched at all. Verification was unusually well-corroborated on this row: executionRoutesVerbatim is exactly equal to v7's executionRoutes across all five routes, v7's conformanceModel.standing independently confirms six of the eight obligations in one field, the hostile-goldens string is verbatim in the live file-08 evidence cell, and G21 v3's own registerRow is DR-114 so that leftover demonstrably stays put. TWO WORDING ITEMS logged as observations, neither affecting any measured property. First, the purpose clause 'Replace predecessor self-version closing sentence' has no antecedent here — v1 had no predecessor block and no self-version sentence; the clause is wave boilerplate present in nine joins, eight of which did have a real antecedent. Second, OBL-AL3-CORE-ROLLBACK labels D-121's recording 'DR-110 leftover T2-02', but D-121's heading reads 'accepted design-contract successor candidate' and its full entry contains no 'T2-02' or 'leftover' at all, whereas D-124 and D-125 headings do use the leftover-T2-02 label. The locus is right, the kind label is not; the obligation stays leftover-design regardless and the error runs conservative. Both are byte-carried from the ACCEPTed v1 and outside v2's remeasurement scope; both are worth tidying in a successor.
